test_policy.notes: UC does not consider SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions or scholarships. Scores may be self-reported only after submitting the application, and are used for eligibility alternatives or placement after enrollment.

requirements.notes: Fee is $80 per campus, $95 for international applicants; fee waivers cover up to four campuses but only for U.S. citizens, permanent residents and AB540-eligible applicants. UC does not require or read letters of recommendation at application. The 4 Personal Insight Questions are the only essays (no campus supplement).

deadlines.label: UC application filing period closes
deadlines.note: Admission decisions released March 1-31, 2027 (some campuses earlier)
deadlines.notes: No early plans. Application opens August 1, 2026 for fall 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if your native language is not English and your secondary school education was in a country where English is not the language of instruction. Exams must be completed by December; self-report scores in the UC application.

english.notes: Tests completed January 2026 or later (1-6 scale).

aid.notes: UCSD says international students are not eligible for federal or state financial aid and must prove sufficient funds for a visa. No institutional scholarship program for first-year internationals was found on the pages checked.

sat.note: UCSD is test-blind: SAT/ACT are not considered for admission; the code applies to scores sent after admission (placement, ELWR).

act.note: UCSD is test-blind; code applies to scores sent after admission.

toefl.note: No undergraduate TOEFL code is published on the admissions pages. Self-report scores in the UC application; send official scores only after admission, to the campus you enroll at.

ielts.note: No code. Self-report in the UC application; send official scores after admission only to the enrolling campus.

duolingo.note: No code. Self-report in the UC application; send official scores after admission only to the enrolling campus.

tier_notes.engineering: Jacobs School is a top-15 engineering school.
tier_notes.business: No business administration degree; Rady School co-runs a B.S. in Business Economics.
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Top-15 life sciences (biological sciences, neuroscience, oceanography at Scripps).
